- If `name` is `"__root__"`, `n->item` is set to the first entry in the `menu.master` list.
- If `name` is not `"__root__"`, `n->item` is set using the `get_item_from_tag(name)` function.

### Relationships

The change alters the logic for how nodes are created based on their names, specifically handling the special case of the root node differently from other nodes. This ensures that the root node is correctly initialized with the first item in the master list, while other nodes continue to retrieve their items based on tags.
